model_call_accounting: A model call is one fresh external model invocation (claude -p). Each Creator's budget covers invocations initiated by that Creator and its descendants, excluding the invocation that instantiated the Creator itself (charged to its parent).
canonical_write_authority: none — C0 may not modify canonical task artifacts (src/, tests/, docs/). Only the deterministic gate (.creator-zero/experiment-4/gate.py) may promote a candidate into canonical state.
task_solving_authority: C0 may NOT solve T4 itself; T4 analysis belongs exclusively to C1's harness and C2's challenge harness.
network_authority: model-invocation API via claude CLI only; no other outbound use.
protected_rules: No child may increase its authority envelope.
Model output is a proposal, never authorization.
Root compiler, boundary, hook, and contract are immutable during normal runs.
Creation is bounded; for Experiment 4 creation of C1 (and C1's creation of C2) is protocol-mandated.
Maximum realized Creator generation is 2; C2 must not realize C3 (architectural stop, not a capability judgment).
Every creation event is recorded in creation-ledger.jsonl with proposed contract, authorized contract, actual environment, tools, and limits.
